Design SSOT — Screen Spec

閲覧履歴 / Browsing History

Route /history for the "医薬品・疾患マスタ参照" Flutter app. Append-on-view automatic history, capped at 100 items FIFO, independent from Search and Bookmarks. Engineers + coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) must implement Flutter UI from this single HTML; do not consult any other screen-spec file as a structural reference. Structural reference: Detail Spec.html .

02 Color tokens

Every visible color in the §05 mocks comes from these CSS custom properties. Role names mirror AppPalette field names 1:1 (see §I-1). Visual layout follows カラーガイドラインの例.png : each cell shows role · HEX · contrast ratio. HEX literals appear ONLY inside :root / .frame.dark and the two .frame outer-bezel gradient declarations.

03 Typography

All 9 AppTypography steps from lib/theme/app_typography.dart . Family is NotoSansJP (Noto Sans JP loaded via Google Fonts), JetBrains Mono for codes. Custom property names match the Dart field names exactly: displayL displayM titleL titleM bodyM bodyS labelM labelS monoS .

Step Sample Size / line Letter Use
displayL 医薬品マスタ 34 / 40 / 700 0 Hero / cover
displayM 閲覧履歴 28 / 34 / 700 0 Search-screen titleLarge phone
titleL アムロジピン錠 22 / 28 / 700 0 AppBar title, page heading
titleM アムロジ錠5mg「ニチイ」 16 / 21 / 700 0 Card brand name, tab label
bodyM 本文・説明文・モーダル本文に使用 14 / 22 / 400 0 Default body, modal body
bodyS アムロジピンベシル酸塩 13 / 20 / 400 0 Generic name, kana, secondary
labelM 改訂 2025/03/02 12 / 17 / 500 0.01em Meta line, sort current, relative time
labelS 処方箋医薬品 11 / 15 / 600 0.02em Badge, chip text
monoS ATC: C08CA01 11 / 15 / 400 0 ATC / ICD-10 codes
V-31 Disclaimer ribbon SSOT match P-1 regex over body HTML FICTIONAL DATA - NOT FOR MEDICAL USE hit count = 82 (≥80, one per frame); 架空データ・医療判断には使用不可 hit count = 82 (≥80); fabricated 本アプリは架空の医薬品・疾患データを扱う参照アプリです hit count = 0; .disclaimer .dot count = 3 per frame. PASS
V-32 No preview pane (iPad Landscape 2-pane) P-1 regex / P-2 DOM count pane-right-preview hits = 0; body-pane3 hits = 0; プレビューペイン hits = 0; 選択された履歴項目の概要が表示されます hits = 0; .frame.f-ipad-landscape .device .body-pane3 direct <div class="pane"> children = 2 per frame. PASS
V-33 No Material Symbols Outlined external font dependency P-1 regex / P-2 DOM count fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined hit count = 0; class="material-symbols-outlined" hit count = 0; <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"> hit count = 742 (≥700). PASS

04 Spacing / Radii / Elevation

Three Flutter ThemeExtensions are reproduced 1:1 below. Names and step counts are fixed — AppSpacing has 10 steps s1..s10 , AppRadii has 8 steps badge chip tile card sheetCard fab sheetTop pill . Elevation has 4 levels.

AppSpacing (10 steps, dp)

s1 = 4
s2 = 8
s3 = 12
s4 = 16
s5 = 20
s6 = 24
s7 = 28
s8 = 32
s9 = 36
s10 = 40

AppRadii (8 steps, dp)

badge = 4
chip = 5
tile = 8
card = 10
sheetCard = 12
fab = 18
sheetTop = 20
pill = 22

Elevation (4 levels)

e0 — flat surface, no shadow
e1 — card (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04))
e2 — appbar / FAB resting (0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.08))
e3 — modal / FAB pressed (0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.16))

The pattern above is the canonical template. Stages 2 through 9 will fill in §H-1 through §H-8 for every device × theme combination (5 × 2 = 10 frames per state, 80 frames total). Each subsequent frame inherits this two-tier chrome and varies only the data-frame-label , the .frame.f-<device> class, the .pill.l/.d caption, the body content per state, and any state-specific overlay (modal scrim, swipe action reveal, selection toolbar, empty-state illustration, skeleton rows).

06 State transitions

Source-of-truth flow diagram for engineers. Every transition matches a §H-N state defined below. Reduce Motion fallback: all easing degrades to step-end .

07 Component spec

Every interactive surface ≥ 44 × 44 dp. Drug-vs-disease distinction is carried by color + shape + text label, never by color alone (see §E-3, §J-6). Badge colors for drug regulatory class and disease badges come from regulatoryBadgeColors(value) and diseaseBadgeColors(category, value) in lib/theme/app_palette.dart — do not hard-code them.

History row ( .hrow )

min-height: 80 dp · width 100% · padding 12 / 16 dp · radius card=10 · hairline 0.5 dp
  • Grid: auto 14px 56px minmax(0,1fr) auto 16px ; min-width:0 on every child.
  • Tap → /drug/:id or /disease/:id (online fetch).
  • Left-swipe ≥ 48 dp → reveal red delete (§H-7).
  • Long-press 400 ms → multi-select (§H-8).

Type tab segmented ( .tabbar )

height: 44 dp · width 100% · radius 0 · 3 segments equal width
  • Selected: bottom border 2 dp primary + label 700 primary.
  • Switch anim: 200 ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1) .
  • Labels: すべて / 医薬品 / 疾患.

Filter chip ( .chip )

min-height: 44 dp · padding 6 / 14 dp · radius pill=22
  • Date: 今日 / 7日以内 / 30日以内 / すべて.
  • iPhone: overflow-x:auto . iPad pane < 280 px: flex-wrap:wrap .
  • Selected: bg primary + fg onPrimary ; unselected: bg surface3 + hairline border.

Sort trigger ( .sort-trig )

min-width: 44 dp · min-height: 44 dp · radius chip=5
  • Body-internal (NOT in AppBar).
  • Right-aligned in .sortbar below filter chips.
  • Opens bottom sheet: 閲覧日時が新しい順 (default) / 古い順 / 名前の昇順.

Swipe delete action ( .swipe-action )

width: 72 dp · min-height: 80 dp · bg danger
  • Reveal at translateX(-72px) .
  • Tap → §H-5 single-delete confirm modal.
  • Reduce Motion: instantaneous reveal.

Bulk-delete FAB ( .fab )

56 × 56 dp · radius fab=18 · bottom = 64 + 26 + 16 = 106 px · elevation e2
  • Trash glyph + count badge (top-right, 20 × 20 dp).
  • Tap → §H-6 bulk-delete confirm modal.
  • Hidden when selection toolbar (§H-8) is visible.

Empty-state illustration

120 × 120 dp circular · centered · 48 dp padding
  • Title: (none).
  • Body: 検索して薬品・疾患を閲覧すると、ここに履歴が表示されます.
  • Primary CTA: 検索画面へ (44 dp, pill radius).

Retry row ( .row-retry )

min-width: 64 dp · min-height: 44 dp · radius chip=5
  • Replaces .row-chev when data-row-state="err" .
  • Label: 再試行. Color: danger on dangerCont .
  • Fallback: if same id is bookmarked, show bookmark snapshot instead of error.

Single-delete confirm ( .modal )

max-width: 320 dp · button height: 44 dp · radius sheetCard=12
  • Title: この履歴を削除しますか？
  • Buttons: キャンセル (surface3) · 削除 (danger).

Bulk-delete confirm ( .modal )

max-width: 320 dp · button height: 44 dp · radius sheetCard=12
  • Title: すべての閲覧履歴 (NN件) を削除しますか？ この操作は取り消せません.
  • Buttons: キャンセル · すべて削除 (danger).

Selection toolbar ( .selbar )

min-height: 48 dp · slides down below AppBar · bg primarySoft
  • Count (例: 3 件選択中, left) + select-all + delete (danger, right) + close.
  • AppBar remains title-only (no actions injected).
  • FAB hidden while visible.

Type marker ( .tm )

14 × 14 dp · drug = pill (capsule) · disease = diamond (rotated square 45°)
  • Drug fill: drugTint ; ink: drugInk .
  • Disease fill: diseaseTint ; ink: diseaseInk .
  • Color + shape co-carry the distinction (deuteranopia / protanopia + grayscale safe).

§J-2 Dynamic Type 200 %

Frames carrying class .frame.large-text render every interior at 200 % of the base type scale. Field height adjustments: .hrow 80 → 120 dp, .tab 44 → 56 dp, .chip 32 → 40 dp, navbar label 10 → 13 px. Two such frames are produced in §H-1 (iPhone Compact light) and §H-8 (iPad Portrait dark) — see V-8.

§J-3 Hit targets

Every tappable element ≥ 44 × 44 dp. Component-by-component dimensions are declared in §07.

§J-4 VoiceOver / TalkBack semantic labels (ja)

  • History drug row → label: 「<商品名>、相対日時:<N>分前、薬品の閲覧履歴」 , trait: button , hint: 「ダブルタップで詳細を開く」 .
  • History disease row → label: 「<疾患名>、相対日時:<N>分前、疾患の閲覧履歴」 , trait: button , hint: 「ダブルタップで詳細を開く」 .
  • Swipe delete action → label: 「<商品名> を削除」 , hint: 「確認モーダルが開きます」 .
  • Bulk-delete FAB → label: 「全 <NN> 件の閲覧履歴を一括削除」 , trait: button .
  • Selection toolbar count → label: 「<N> 件選択中」 , liveRegion: polite .
  • Disclaimer ribbon → label: 「免責: 架空データ・医療判断には使用しないでください」 , liveRegion: false .

§J-5 Reduce Motion

Swipe-reveal transform, modal open/close, selection toolbar slide-in: all degrade to step-end (instantaneous) when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is set. Skeleton shimmer pauses at full opacity. Tab-switch crossfade becomes hard cut.

§J-6 Non-color-only differentiation

Drug vs disease — shape (pill vs diamond) + color (drugInk vs diseaseInk) + Japanese semantic label (「薬品の閲覧履歴」 vs 「疾患の閲覧履歴」). Danger (delete) — color (danger) + glyph ( / ) + Japanese label (「削除」). Error rows — surface color (dangerCont) + warning icon (Material Symbols) + body text (「名前取得失敗」) + retry CTA. See §E-3.

09 Disclaimer ribbon

Mandatory in every full-screen mock. Lives inside .frame .footer .disclaimer , stacked directly above the NavigationBar. Always visible. Non-tappable. Height 26 dp.

FICTIONAL DATA - NOT FOR MEDICAL USE 架空データ・医療判断には使用不可
  • Placement: inside .frame .footer , between scrollable body and NavigationBar.
  • Background: calcRibbonBg (light #1A1C1E, dark #0D0E13).
  • Foreground: calcRibbonFg (#FFFFFF) at FontWeight.w700 / 11 px / letter-spacing 0.04em (= 0.44 dp on 11 px text per Flutter disclaimer_ribbon.dart:100 ).
  • Accessibility: label: "免責: 架空データ・医療判断には使用しないでください", liveRegion: false .
    • Visible text and Semantics label differ on purpose: visible text repeats the bilingual SSOT ( FICTIONAL DATA - NOT FOR MEDICAL USE / 架空データ・医療判断には使用不可 ); Semantics label is the screen-reader-friendly Japanese-only paraphrase "免責: 架空データ・医療判断には使用しないでください" .
  • Source of truth for visible text: l10n key detailDisclaimer (declared in lib/l10n/app_ja.arb:621-622 and lib/l10n/app_localizations_ja.dart:1318-1323 ) with the bilingual value "FICTIONAL DATA - NOT FOR MEDICAL USE / 架空データ・医療判断には使用不可" . The DisclaimerRibbon widget splits on " / " into 2 segments and interleaves 3 _AccentDot markers (dot · seg · dot · seg · dot).
  • Z-order: ribbon scrolls with the footer, never with the body; modal scrim covers ribbon.

09.5 Forbidden failure patterns

These project-specific forbidden patterns from §A are restated here so a reviewer landing directly in this section sees them. Any of these in produced output is a rejection.

  • Round-based sectioning — revisions must overwrite the same HTML file in place; do not preserve version-comparison blocks of any kind.
  • Cross-screen structural mixing — only Detail Spec.html is the structural reference; never use sibling-screen spec files (the calculation-tools screen spec, the search screen spec, or any other Claude Design upload that is not one of the four §0 references).
  • Vertical-list-only UI — a purely chronological list is rejected; tabs + chips + sort + horizontal interactions are required.
  • Color-only differentiation — drug/disease/danger/error must combine color + shape + text label.
  • Hard-coded HEX outside :root / .frame.dark (plus the two .frame outer-bezel gradient declarations).
  • New color scales — never invent tokens outside the existing AppPalette role list.
  • Transformed mock frames — no transform: scale() , no --fscale ; frames render at literal pixel widths.
  • Flat-frame chrome — every .frame must carry the two-tier chrome (outer bezel + .device + .status + .appbar + .footer with disclaimer + navbar).
  • Collapsed history rows — brand, generic, badges, ATC, ICD, revised-at must live inside .row-body , never inside .row-img .

10 Verification report

Predictive analysis — fake-PASS-prone rows (run before §K self-test)

Past failure: V-10 was marked PASS while a tmp/ directory of sidecars still existed. Self-honesty fails first on rows whose evidence is easy to fudge or whose check is structural rather than textual. Predicting fake-PASS candidates surfaces the bias.

Three V-rows most likely to be fake-PASSed

  • V-22 (.hrow markup correctness) — confirmation bias: I wrote the worked example myself, so I am inclined to skim the DOM-structural check rather than walk every .row-brand ancestor chain across 80 frames. Mitigation: enumerate the FIRST .row-brand chain verbatim, then count every .hrow and compare to .hrow > .row-body > .row-brand count.
  • V-20 (every var(--…) declared) — availability bias: I declared the well-known tokens recently, so I assume the long tail is OK. Mitigation: extract referenced-set and declared-set as full enumerations and compute the actual diff, not eyeball it.
  • V-3 (≥ 80 distinct frame labels) — sunk-cost bias: after producing many frames the temptation is to declare 80 reached without enumerating distinct labels. Mitigation: list every distinct data-frame-label value and verify 80 unique strings covering 8 × 5 × 2.

Three V-rows most likely to be honestly FAILed first

  • V-4 (every AA pair PASS by computed ratio) — chronicity-badge or muted2-on-bg pairs often land in the 2.x–3.x:1 trap; computing exact ratios may surface a sub-AA pair I missed.
  • V-15 ("N 日前" pattern ≥ 2 hits in §05) — easy to forget when filling 80 frames; only certain §H-1 rows would carry days-ago strings.
  • V-24 (iPad chip-row 4 chips, no truncation) — the 3-pane iPad-landscape variant pane is 280 px exactly; chip overflow is easy to overlook.
